subject.title: feat(memory-core): optional cross-encoder rerank stage for memory search

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new public MemoryRerankProvider plugin SDK seam with a single manifest-gated exclusive slot for builtin memory search reranking?
rationale: Repository policy treats plugin SDK and manifest additions as compatibility-sensitive public contracts, and this PR intentionally adds exactly that new contract while the RFC remains open.

options.title: Accept this SDK seam
options.body: Land the registration-based rerank provider contract after conflict resolution and keep the concrete remote reranker implementation as a separate plugin.

options.title: Redirect to existing supplement path
options.body: Reject this seam and pursue the MemoryCorpusSupplement engine-candidate work if maintainers prefer fewer memory plugin contracts.

options.title: Pause for external-reranker design
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers prefer a concrete remote-reranker plugin/config path like the broader external-reranker PR.

recommendation.title: Accept this SDK seam
recommendation.body: Land the registration-based rerank provider contract after conflict resolution and keep the concrete remote reranker implementation as a separate plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history across memory search and plugin SDK/manifest boundary files affected by the API decision.
